images.caption: An Auckland Society of Arts medal awarded to A.A. Whitehorne for "Best Part Song" in 1886 by Mrs McCosh Clark. Designed by Anton Teutenberg. Diameter of 45mm. Designs on the front include kowhaiwhai on the outer band, beading, an engraved inner band reading "V.E.C T.A.E. CUM LARIBUS ARTES", and a centre in YM (potentially gold) and lyre. Designs on the back include engraved text reading "AUCKLAND SOCIETY OF ARTS", a shield with engraved text reading "PRESENTED BY / Mrs / McCosh Clark / A.A. WHITEHORNE / FOR BEST / PART SONG / 1886", an "open laurel wreath", and beading. The medal has an attached ring at the top. The designer's name is included on either side of the inner rim with smaller text reading "A.TEUTENBERG / AUCKLAND. N.Z.".
images.alt: An Auckland Society of Arts medal awarded to A.A. Whitehorne for "Best Part Song" in 1886 by Mrs McCosh Clark. Designed by Anton Teutenberg. Diameter of 45mm.
